fields.statement: Verified at 29d12aca. go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/web/... passes: TestAPIAnswersTheHandlersJSON compares GET /api/run.ls, /api/run.ls?limit=5 and /api/roadmap bodies byte-for-byte with canon.Marshal of the api handlers' responses on a fixture repo (init + change.new), the same bytes cmd/rhiza writeResponse prints for --json; TestAPIRefusesWrites shows GET of land, accept, daemon.set, daemon.start, render, ship.merge, add, apply answers 404/405, POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH answer 405, an unknown query key 400. go test ./internal/api -run TestReadOnlyMarker passes: it asserts ReadOnly on the 16 operations the web UI uses, on no other operation, never with Write or Record, and not on daemon.set, daemon.start, render, ship.merge, the ship/run/session/inbox writes or any log write. Read the diff: Operation.ReadOnly is a new explicit flag separate from Write; ReadOnlyHandler refuses non-GET/HEAD with 405 and any op lacking the marker with 404, builds the request from the query via DecodeRequest, and strips Record/DryRun/Rex/Start/Stdin from a copied Ctx. Spot-read the marked handlers (search, inbox, daemon.status) and found no writes to the log, settings, Rex or GitHub. go vet and gofmt clean; describe-golden testscript passes.
